Reusable parameter annotations may vary as required by the checker. Valid dimensions are 0..32 inclusive; cells contains exactly width*height binary values in row-major order. The exterior is permanently dead, with no wrapping. Each synchronous step counts the eight OLD-board neighbors excluding the center: birth at three, survival at two or three, otherwise death. Return the complete ordered board, preserving binary range, exact shape and reusable input. evolve(0,w,h,c)=c; evolve performs exactly turns steps; evolving a then b agrees with a+b; empty boards remain empty. Finite behavioral gates exercise turns 0..8 but are not a universal proof. Invalid shapes, nonbinary inputs and dimensions outside the domain are unspecified. Only Base is imported; no foreign code, IO, holes, unsafe annotations, new axioms or fixture-specific behavior. No speed, GPU or universal correctness claim is established by this style review.

import Base

def Life.rule(cell: U32, +neighbors: U32) -> U32:
  Bool.to_u32(
    Bool.or(
      U32.is_eq(neighbors, 3),
      Bool.and(U32.is_eq(cell, 1), U32.is_eq(neighbors, 2))))

def Life.peek(cells: List<&2, U32>) -> U32:
  Maybe.default(&2, U32, List.head(&2, U32, cells), 0)

def Life.row(
  +current: List<&2, U32>,
  +above: List<&2, U32>,
  +below: List<&2, U32>,
  left_current: U32,
  left_above: U32,
  left_below: U32
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match current:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case cell <> rest:
      +above_rest = List.tail(&2, U32, above)
      +below_rest = List.tail(&2, U32, below)
      +north = Life.peek(above)
      +south = Life.peek(below)
      northeast = Life.peek(above_rest)
      east = Life.peek(rest)
      southeast = Life.peek(below_rest)
      +neighbors = (
        left_above + north + northeast
        + left_current + east
        + left_below + south + southeast : U32)
      Life.rule(cell, neighbors) <>
        Life.row(rest, above_rest, below_rest, cell, north, south)

def Life.rows.go(
  cells: List<&2, U32>,
  +width: Nat,
  remaining: Nat,
  reversed: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, List<&2, U32>>:
  match cells:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case cell <> rest:
      match remaining:
        case 0n:
          Life.rows.go(rest, width, width, reversed)
        case 1n+more:
          match more:
            case 0n:
              List.reverse(&2, U32, cell <> reversed) <>
                Life.rows.go(rest, width, width, Nil{})
            case 1n+tail:
              Life.rows.go(rest, width, 1n+tail, cell <> reversed)

def Life.board(
  +rows: List<&2, List<&2, U32>>,
  +zero: List<&2, U32>,
  above: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match rows:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case current <> rest:
      below = Maybe.default(
        &2,
        List<&2, U32>,
        List.head(&2, List<&2, U32>, rest),
        zero)
      List.append(
        &2,
        U32,
        Life.row(current, above, below, 0, 0, 0),
        Life.board(rest, zero, current))

def step(
  width: U32,
  height: U32,
  cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  +w = U32.to_nat(width)
  +zero = List.replicate(U32, w, 0)
  Life.board(
    Life.rows.go(cells, w, w, Nil{}),
    zero,
    zero)

def evolve(
  turns: Nat,
  +width: U32,
  +height: U32,
  cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match turns:
    case 0n:
      cells
    case 1n+prior:
      evolve(prior, width, height, step(width, height, cells))
